name: Player
source:
Player is a Keyblade Wielder that has recently awoken in Daybreak Town. They can be of any gender and their appearance is customizable. After picking a Union, meeting Ephemer and Skuld, they find themselves in the middle of a war that will devastate their town.

They are referred to as Player by fans.
